IS 19151 : 2025 Ultramarine Blue for Plastics - Specification
ICS 83.080, 83.140.01
ICS 83.080, 83.140.01
PCD 12
PCD 12
1 SCOPE
The standard specifies the requirements and methods of sampling and test for ultramarine blue for use in plastics that may be regarded as safe for use in contact with foodstuff and pharmaceuticals.
2 REFERENCES
The standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of the standards.
